# A-Share Market Intelligence

A read-only market intelligence and strategy research system focused on A-shares,
with lighter coverage of Korean and US markets.

The planned pipeline collects source-linked market data and news, tracks events
and capital flows, and produces evidence-backed daily research reports. Facts,
inferences and conditional scenarios remain distinct. It does not trade or manage
a portfolio, and it does not promise investment returns.

## Current Status

P0-P4M are human-merged in this public repository. Stage1 retains source gaps;
Stage2 core and the Stage3-7 offline engineering foundation are merged.
P4 adds local three-part reports, an append-only ledger, linked corrections and
simulated delivery safeguards. It does not complete the research MVP, full
Stage8 or verify live model/Telegram integration.

Merged P4C implements a configurable offline workflow before final model hookup.
It connects variable authored scenarios, bounded research, local reports and
persistent task/ledger operations. No external permission is enabled.
The [offline plan](docs/OFFLINE_WORKFLOW_PLAN.md), historical
[live integration plan](docs/LIVE_INTEGRATION_PLAN.md) and
[prerequisite register](docs/evidence/live-integration-prerequisites.json)
separate free-source rights, implementation, actual observations and account
choices. Unknown account status means not established, not proof of absence.
Final operational integration must pin those choices and its audited scope.
See [Blueprint v1](BLUEPRINT.md), [P4 methods](docs/P4_METHODS.md) and
[canonical state](project-state/state.json) for scope and lifecycle status.

The local foundation includes bounded RSS capture, offline market CSV parsing,
an SQLite provenance store, strict timestamps, domain-specific evidence checks,
immutable reference bundles, retention and hash-verified replay. A fixed five-index
profile remains **BLOCKED_MARKET_SOURCES**. Before the P4B one-shot, the frozen
source baseline is0/5 live-verified; its separate observation receipt records
actual partial acquisition without changing full five-index/MVP acceptance.
This is an unresolved access/rights/implementation gap, not five failed requests.
The [source matrix](docs/SOURCE_MATRIX.md) records candidate sources and limits.
The [probe record](docs/evidence/p1-source-probe.json) records the actual probe
status, including when it has not run. An RSS result cannot satisfy index coverage.

P1's original official Federal Reserve press observation remains historical.
P4S's one official-news request is completed and its allowance consumed. General
retrieval stays disabled. P4I closes both historical probe and preparation gates.
P4S left BaoStock disabled pending rights/transport clarification; the bounded
P4B exception below does not reopen historical gates. See the historical
[bounded source plan](docs/FREE_SOURCE_COLLECTION.md). Market normalization
fixtures are synthetic. The paid-provider boundary is disabled, not connected.
Scheduling, live models, real Telegram, trading and VPS remain outside P4.
Local report rendering and fake delivery are explicitly synthetic, not connected.

This repository began as a sanitized import, documented in
[the publication manifest](docs/PUBLICATION_PROVENANCE.json). Historical P0
receipts are preserved unchanged; [P0 merge evidence](docs/reviews/p0-merge.json)
[P1 merge evidence](docs/reviews/p1-merge.json) and
[P2 merge evidence](docs/reviews/p2-merge.json) and
[P3 merge evidence](docs/reviews/p3-merge.json) and
[P4 merge evidence](docs/reviews/p4-merge.json) and
[P4L merge evidence](docs/reviews/p4l-merge.json) and
[P4C merge evidence](docs/reviews/p4c-merge.json) and
[P4S merge evidence](docs/reviews/p4s-merge.json) and
[P4E merge evidence](docs/reviews/p4e-merge.json) and
[P4I merge evidence](docs/reviews/p4i-merge.json) and
[P4N merge evidence](docs/reviews/p4n-merge.json) and
[P4M merge evidence](docs/reviews/p4m-merge.json) record actual public closeout.

[Canonical state](project-state/state.json) and local review receipts describe
the frozen pre-publication snapshot. `NOT_RUN_AT_SNAPSHOT` is not the live GitHub
status. Subsequent exact-head runs, protection checks and merge evidence belong
on the public pull request. Future live integration and MVP acceptance require
this package's human merge and their own reviewed scope; no later external work
is authorized implicitly.

## Anonymous NBS Ingestion

The [P4N plan](docs/NBS_EVIDENCE_INGESTION.md) groups anonymous official NBS RSS
collection, bounded normalized metadata retention and provenance-bound evidence
composition. The user excludes registration and API keys; keyed candidates are
not current integrations. All five fixed benchmarks remain0/5 live-verified.

P4N's exact one-shot was independently reviewed, released and executed before
PR11 was human-merged. The result was FAILED/content_length, with0 observed body
bytes and no capture/parse/composition. The receipt does not identify which header
check failed; it is not proof that the remote feed was empty or simply too large.
Its allowance is consumed. P4M closes the NBS collection gate alongside the old
Fed probe/preparation gates. General collection, models, Telegram, trading,
scheduler and VPS stay disabled.
No article or attachment is followed. Raw XML and descriptions are not retained.
Only explicitly attributed NBS items with known publication timezone and safe
locators can enter retained normalized metadata. Missing attribution/time fields
are rejection counts, not invented values or an accepted empty-event day.

The new normalized_only policy class keeps normalized titles subject to an expiry
while denying raw retention. Actual acquisition and request IDs remain bound to
the subsequent private historical-replay composition. Metadata hashes cannot
reconstruct the discarded raw feed or prove its underlying assertions. Actual
observations, including failed requests or no eligible items, must remain visible
and cannot authorize retries or promote index/research/MVP acceptance.

Historical NBS commands include `collect`, `status`, `compose` and `sweep`.
Collection is now blocked by the active gate; a later branch or opt-in flag cannot
renew its allowance. This package does not execute any of these commands or read
their private store. The non-collection commands never fetch. Missing, expired or corrupt stores
are not recreated to renew collection. All public command output is sanitized;
private evidence is not exported. Cleanup preserves request history and hashes.
The [observation receipt](docs/evidence/p4n-nbs-observation.json) distinguishes
NOT_RUN, RECORDED, FAILED and UNKNOWN without claiming source completeness.

Every completion report now separates earlier completed work, this package's
completed work and remaining work. See [PR11 merge evidence](docs/reviews/p4n-merge.json).

## Daily Market Evidence

The [P4M plan](docs/DAILY_MARKET_EVIDENCE.md) connects bounded supplied daily
responses to existing market-domain computation in one offline work package.
It targets the two documented mainland mappings without shrinking the five-index
goal. Unknown publication time remains unknown: an observation after a closed
session is not a reconstructed publication instant or proof of finality.

Actual transport provenance must be distinguished from documentation links.
Caller-provided records, source-policy declarations and hashes do not prove
acquisition or entitlement. There is no SDK, collector, runtime-store importer,
new source request, model or delivery permission. Authored test input coverage
does not change0/5 live verification, and the existing synthetic consumers remain
separate. Full MVP still needs genuine source/research/private-delivery evidence.

## Bounded Mainland Observation

The [P4B plan](docs/BAOSTOCK_LIVE_EVIDENCE.md) integrates an explicitly authorized
anonymous two-index test, pinned optional SDK dependencies and the existing
daily-market computation. It allows one independently reviewed/released session,
at most12 protocol requests, no retry or paid/keyed access. The SDK's public TCP
channel is unencrypted and unauthenticated; no HTTPS acquisition is claimed.

The user's results-only retention requirement is enforced by keeping all market
payloads and intermediate values in bounded memory, never disk/stdout/Git.
After same-process calculation and verification they are discarded; only sanitized
run IDs, counts, hashes, limitations and durable request-accounting metadata remain.
These hashes cannot recreate a retained dataset. Unknown publication/finality and
the other three index gaps remain explicit. This does not enable models, Telegram,
scheduling, trading or VPS, or satisfy live research/MVP acceptance.

The base offline application remains stdlib-only. P4B uses a separate optional
[dependency lock](requirements-baostock.lock) and [SDK manifest](config/p4b_sdk_manifest.json)
in an isolated CPython3.12 environment; do not install globally or use unpinned
source distributions. Installation and offline tests do not authorize collection.
The active contract, actual pre-probe release and CLI opt-in must all agree before
`python -m market_intelligence.baostock_capture observe --allow-network` can run.
`python -m market_intelligence.baostock_capture status` returns sanitized metadata
only and never fetches. Deleting the journal to repeat a test is not supported.
The actual [observation receipt](docs/evidence/p4b-market-observation.json), when
present, records success, partial results, failure or unknown outcome honestly.

## Retained Evidence Preparation

The [P4E preparation plan](docs/EVIDENCE_PREPARATION.md) defines a local boundary
for already captured official-news evidence. It preserves real source identity
and capture/publication/first-seen times; local historical processing is not
a new live observation. Typed Facts and deduplication do not produce an accepted
research bundle or allow real data into the synthetic research/report APIs.

P4E's separately reviewed local preparation ran before its human merge. Its
[immutable result](docs/evidence/p4e-preparation.json) prepared20 inputs, with8
eligible and12 stale at the original observation point. P4I does not repeat it:
the historical `preparation prepare` command is now blocked by the active gate.
The old command never creates or changes that store, fetches content or reads credentials.
Expired or unavailable content remains unavailable; the public diagnostic output
contains counts/IDs/hashes and limitations, not news titles or private paths.
See the immutable [P4S observation](docs/evidence/p4s-source-probe.json): its feed
result is degraded, news freshness remains BLOCK and live benchmarks remain0/5.
Do not delete the input store to renew a request allowance. P4E does not run
retention cleanup; the historical collection tool's explicit sweep is separate
from this read-only preparation operation. P4E did not test or enable BaoStock.

## Mode-Safe Evidence Composition

The [P4I plan](docs/REAL_EVIDENCE_COMPOSITION.md) adds a separate, pure in-memory
composition boundary for caller-supplied real-source Facts. Their source mode
remains `live_observation`, while processing is explicitly `historical_replay`.
Original evidence times and source identities are preserved. This is not a new
live run, a collector, a runtime-store importer or a research/report dispatcher.
The legacy synthetic APIs, scenarios and demos remain separate and unchanged.

Source-policy assessments are specific to a source, operation and personal local
research purpose. Applicable retention and local-analysis rights must permit the
current operation; unknown future model/delivery rights do not independently
block local composition, but those operations remain disabled. A caller-supplied
policy is an auditable specification, not proof of entitlement or authenticity.

Retention is checked against actual processing time, including on verification.
Missing mappings, calendars, constituents, benchmark data and flow remain visible
gaps, not synthetic replacements or zero-filled successes. Input-domain results
do not change operational readiness: it remains `BLOCKED_EXTERNAL_PREREQUISITES`,
with no permission grant, no new live runs and0/5 live-verified benchmarks.

There is no new CLI, export or persistent store for these bundles. Existing
research and publication entrypoints reject their distinct schema. A later
reviewed importer must bind actual acquisition, source identity and rejection
records before genuine research can consume real evidence. Current tests use
authored real-shaped inputs, not actual observations. Source selection and the
final model/private-delivery integration remain outstanding.

## Configurable Offline Workflow

Python 3.12 and the standard library are sufficient; no model account or key is
needed. Run all commands from the checkout. Replace angle-bracket placeholders
with absolute paths outside every Git checkout. The workspace is a directory;
case/report arguments are files. Existing export targets are never overwritten.

```text
python -m market_intelligence.workflow example --output <absolute-case.json>
python -m market_intelligence.workflow validate --input <absolute-case.json>
python -m market_intelligence.workflow run --input <absolute-case.json> --workspace <absolute-workspace-directory> --task-key example-1
python -m market_intelligence.workflow status --workspace <absolute-workspace-directory>
python -m market_intelligence.workflow export --workspace <absolute-workspace-directory> --report-id <report-id> --output <absolute-report.txt>
python -m market_intelligence.workflow correct --workspace <absolute-workspace-directory> --report-id <report-id> --reason "Clarification of the offline scenario scope."
```

The case contains `payload`, `methods`, `entities`, `research_config`, `responses`
and `publication_config`, with an explicit synthetic label and schema version.
Use the exported example as the schema reference. Changes to facts require their
content hashes and claim evidence references to match; changed claims need new
exact-content reviewer digests. Invalid or unsupported claims are rejected, not
silently repaired. Research responses are authored scripts, not actual AI output.
Inputs may vary within the bounded schema; the old fixed demos remain unchanged.

`run` persists task intent before work and uses the same workspace's budget and
append-only publication ledger. Repeating a completed task key with identical
input returns its original verified report without new research. Changed intent
fails. Research/publication configurations are pinned per workspace. Do not use
new workspaces to evade quotas; budgets are not global across separate stores.
There are at most32 tasks and16 MiB of workflow state, plus separately bounded
budget/report stores. Input and individual stored/exported records are bounded.

`status` reads recorded task state without creating or resetting stores. It does
not claim current ledger health or remote delivery; `export` revalidates the
current ledger. Interrupted reservations and blocked tasks remain visible and
are not automatically retried. Missing/corrupt stores require investigation,
not deletion, implicit recreation or budget refunds. Explanatory corrections
append to the current lineage leaf; they cannot rewrite factual claims.
Correction notes are selected from fixed non-factual explanations: offline scope,
authored responses versus model output, or simulated acknowledgements versus
real delivery. Arbitrary replacement facts in a correction note are rejected.

Optional explicit `simulate-delivery --workspace <absolute-workspace-directory>
--report-id <report-id>` exercises the local fake transport only. The default
run does not dispatch, and this simulation never contacts Telegram. Failed or
unknown simulated outcomes persist across restarts and prevent blind retries.

This is engineering verification, not live research acceptance. Model hookup
is intentionally last, with zero authorized paid budget. Free sources still
need compatible rights and genuine observations; private Telegram credentials
and actual send remain unverified. Never place credentials in a case or Git.

## Local Reports and Delivery Safeguards

P4 connects the fixed authored P3 synthetic demo to three ordered report parts:
news/events, benchmarks/flow/turnover, and sectors/approved impact claims.
The historical P4 publication boundary recomputes the original fixed demo. P4C
also accepts its separate strictly verified configurable synthetic envelope,
not arbitrary live model output. Every report preserves
evidence, historical as_of, gaps, limitations and research fingerprints.

A separate external SQLite ledger stores immutable research before simulated
delivery. Corrections append a new identity linked to the previous lineage leaf.
Durable chunk identities, sequential sends and persistent limits handle duplicate,
failed and unknown outcomes without automatic retries of ambiguous sends.
The live Telegram adapter is unavailable and reads no credentials.

```text
python -m market_intelligence.publication demo
```

This command uses temporary external stores and no network. Its local report,
linked correction and fake delivery records are offline engineering evidence,
not a real Telegram test, live research, forward observation or accuracy proof.
See [raw demo evidence](docs/evidence/p4-demo.json) and
[the readable sample](docs/evidence/p4-report.txt).

Full MVP remains pending permitted five-index/source access, genuine model runs,
three dated end-to-end live runs, human claim-support assessment and an authorized
private Telegram test/correction. Those are a grouped live-integration acceptance
task, not a reason to fabricate observations or proceed directly to VPS.

## Research Foundation

P3 adds strict claim provenance and a fixed researcher/reviewer/editor protocol.
At most two research/review rounds are permitted. Every selected claim needs
an exact-content review; the editor cannot introduce or rewrite approved claims.
Live adapters remain disabled and never fall back to fabricated successful runs.

A bounded external SQLite budget store reserves calls and token allowances
before dispatch, persists run/day accounting across restarts and fails closed
on unknown usage. This is not a distributed quota service or exact dollar billing.
The demonstration uses an ephemeral store and authored synthetic responses:

```text
python -m market_intelligence.research demo
```

Evaluation separates citation validity from actual semantic support and keeps
missing entailment/usefulness assessments unassessed. T+1/T+3/T+5 calculations
use explicit mapped-market sessions, a pinned anchor and benchmark, and disclose
missing or immature outcomes; descriptive returns do not demonstrate profit.
The [P3 methods](docs/P3_METHODS.md) define denominators and limitations.
The [actual demo sample](docs/evidence/p3-demo.json) is synthetic engineering
evidence, not a model-quality test or a genuine observation window.

## Local Workflows

The P2 offline command uses fixed authored fixtures, reads no credentials and
makes no network requests or persistent writes:

```text
python -m market_intelligence.intelligence demo
```

Its envelope separates actual `run_id` / `generated_at` from historical fixture
`as_of`. The content-addressed result is under `bundle.content`; inspect `status`,
the six `domains`, `live_market_coverage` and `readiness` together. A synthetic
DEGRADED result is expected when optional flow is unavailable. The committed
[demo record](docs/evidence/p2-demo.json) identifies actual execution status.
Verify bundles with `verify_bundle` and the original inputs/configuration. Keep
raw CLI JSON when exporting evidence: numeric representations participate in
the Python canonical hash and must not be coerced by another runtime.

Methods include explicit-universe breadth and turnover, equal-weight sector
returns and rank change over complete declared session windows. Missing history
is `insufficient_history`. Source-linked news groups retain all member IDs and
visible ranking factors; mapping ambiguity stays unresolved. Event states never
infer confirmation from elapsed time. Outcome, expected impact and measured
reaction are separate. See [the method boundaries](docs/P2_METHODS.md) and the
versioned configuration for formulas, universes and limitations.

Sector rotation compares equal-weight returns over the last L sessions with the
preceding nonoverlapping L-session window; it needs 2L+1 closes for every declared
member. Relative turnover divides the current universe total by the mean of the
previous L totals. Rank ties use sector IDs; zero/missing baselines remain null.
News priority uses authority points A=4/B=2/C=0, plus one for unambiguous mapping,
times step decay 2^(-floor(age/half_life)). It is not a truth/profit probability.

Prerequisites for these legacy offline workflows: Git and Python3.12, stdlib only.
P4B's optional isolated SDK dependencies are separate, as described above.
Run from the checkout, using an absolute SQLite **file** path outside every Git
checkout. Use a separate persistent store for real observations so restarting a
process cannot reset that store's daily accounting. Multiple independent stores
are not a system-wide quota service and must not be used to evade limits.

```text
python -m market_intelligence demo --store <absolute-external-demo.sqlite> --task-key demo-1
python -m market_intelligence replay --store <absolute-external-demo.sqlite> --capture-id <capture-id> --parser-version rss-v1
python -m market_intelligence sweep --store <absolute-external-live.sqlite>
```

The demo makes no network requests and labels its authored fixtures
`synthetic_test`. Replay labels records `historical_replay`; it cannot recreate a
past live observation. Probe requires explicit opt-in, current audited permission,
the exact permitted destination and available request budget. It does not follow
feed links, use account credentials, or activate paid providers.

JSON output retains run IDs, UTC times, request/parse denominators, capture IDs
and evidence-gate gaps. Exit code zero means the operation completed, **not** that
market readiness passed; inspect `gate.status`, `mode` and `readiness` together.
Capture IDs identify immutable versions whose metadata contains content and
response hashes; output does not include raw payloads or private store paths.
Reuse the same task key to read a completed result without another dispatch.
Unknown request usage stays reserved and blocks new dispatch for that UTC day.

Limits are two attempts/run, twelve/day/store, one retry, one active lease,
512000 response bytes, ten seconds/attempt and at most 10 MiB for store files.
The Fed raw capture expires after 24 hours. Read paths reject expired payloads;
`sweep` removes eligible raw/normalized content and leaves provenance tombstones.
No background scheduler runs the sweep, so the operator must invoke it.

## Local Validation

Tests are offline and use temporary Git repositories and SQLite stores. Test
transports cannot authorize live verification. CI makes no product HTTP requests.

```text
python -m unittest discover -s tests/governance -p test_*.py -v
python -m unittest discover -s tests/product -p test_*.py -v
python tools/governance.py check
python tools/governance.py prompt --verify
python tools/governance.py bundle
python tools/governance.py gate
git diff --check
```

P4B PR13 is merged. Its actual login failed before any validated response;
its successful engineering checks are not a live data PASS. P4D investigates
that failure with a separately authorized login-only diagnostic and, only after
a supported repair and renewed independent release, one two-index verification.
Old quota and failed evidence are immutable; payloads remain memory-only.
See [the recovery plan](docs/BAOSTOCK_PROTOCOL_RECOVERY.md).

The active construction branch is `stage1-baostock-protocol-recovery`. The gate checks
exact scope, staged/worktree agreement, permissions and content-bound receipts.
On detached CI, `--ci` skips local branch identity only.

## Review and Publication

One coordinator and bounded Builders use disjoint file ownership; independent
read-only agents audit the prompt, implementation and release. CI is additional
validation, not independent review. A local `LOCAL_READY_FOR_PR` result is not
remote CI, human merge, source completeness or deployment authorization.

The public target is `kamrean/a-share-market-intelligence-public`. Main requires
pull requests and both named GitHub Actions governance checks, including for
administrators. Force pushes, deletion and auto-merge are disabled. For a sole
maintainer, GitHub required approving review count is zero; independent agent
review and human merge remain procedural gates, not enforcement of merger identity.

Read [the construction entrypoint](START_CONSTRUCTION_PROMPT.md) before changes.
Only named legacy references are consulted; private history, credentials and raw
runtime artifacts are not imported. Public visibility does not add a license.

name: Governance

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  governance:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-24.04, windows-2022]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    # P4D retains locked setup; both checkpoints and all tests remain offline in CI.
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact PR head
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@6d4fd22b20465ccc0f7354476588e8df7c9ca0e0 # v7
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Install isolated hash-locked binary dependencies
        shell: python
        run: |
          import os
          from pathlib import Path
          import subprocess
          import venv

          target = Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP']) / 'p4b-sdk-venv'
          if target.exists():
              raise RuntimeError('Fresh isolated environment required')
          venv.EnvBuilder(with_pip=True).create(target)
          executable = target / ('Scripts/python.exe' if os.name == 'nt' else 'bin/python')
          environment = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items()
                         if not key.upper().startswith('PIP_')
                         and not key.upper().endswith('_PROXY')
                         and key.upper() != 'NETRC'}
          environment.update(PIP_CONFIG_FILE=os.devnull, NETRC=os.devnull,
                             PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1')
          subprocess.run([str(executable), '-I', '-m', 'pip', '--isolated',
                          '--disable-pip-version-check', '--no-input',
                          '--keyring-provider', 'disabled', 'install', '--no-cache-dir',
                          '--no-compile', '--require-hashes', '--only-binary=:all:',
                          '--index-url', 'https://pypi.org/simple',
                          '-r', 'requirements-baostock.lock'], env=environment, check=True)
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_PATH'], 'a', encoding='utf-8') as output:
              output.write(str(executable.parent) + '\n')
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_ENV'], 'a', encoding='utf-8') as output:
              for key in ('PIP_CONFIG_FILE', 'NETRC', 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE'):
                  output.write(key + '=' + environment[key] + '\n')
      - name: Verify optional dependency closure
        run: python -m pip check
      - name: Offline installed-SDK transport verification
        run: python -m unittest discover -s tests/product -p test_baostock_transport.py -v
      - name: Offline installed-SDK capture integration
        run: python -m unittest discover -s tests/product -p test_baostock_capture.py -v
      - name: Offline two-checkpoint recovery integration
        run: python -m unittest discover -s tests/product -p test_baostock_recovery.py -v
      - name: Offline governance tests
        run: python -m unittest discover -s tests/governance -p test_*.py -v
      - name: Offline source, evidence, research and publication tests
        run: python -m unittest discover -s tests/product -p test_*.py -v
      - name: Scope and canonical consistency
        run: python tools/governance.py check --ci
      - name: Verify deterministic prompt
        run: python tools/governance.py prompt --verify
      - name: Validate local review attestations
        run: python tools/governance.py gate --ci
      - name: Confirm CI cannot authorize either recovery phase
        shell: python
        run: |
          import subprocess
          import sys
          for phase in ('diagnostic', 'verification'):
              result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', 'tools/governance.py',
                                       phase + '-gate', '--ci'], capture_output=True, text=True)
              assert result.returncode == 1 and not result.stdout
              assert '--ci is not runtime authorization' in result.stderr
      - name: Check committed patch whitespace
        run: git diff --check 3cceca6e1534484b9001db16644a98b7b068897b HEAD

class Block(ValueError):

def require(condition, message):

def keys(value, expected, label):
    require(type(value) is dict, f"{label}: expected an object")
    missing, unknown = set(expected) - value.keys(), value.keys() - set(expected)
    require(not missing and not unknown,
            f"{label}: missing fields {sorted(missing)}; unknown fields {sorted(unknown)}")


def exact(value, expected, label):
    """Equality with exact types: False, 0 and null are never interchangeable."""
    require(type(value) is type(expected), f"{label}: wrong type")
    if type(expected) is dict:
        keys(value, expected, label)
        for key, item in expected.items():
            exact(value[key], item, f"{label}.{key}")
    elif type(expected) is list:
        require(len(value) == len(expected), f"{label}: wrong length")
        for index, item in enumerate(expected):
            exact(value[index], item, f"{label}[{index}]")
    else:
        require(value == expected, f"{label}: unexpected value")


def nonempty(value, label):
    require(type(value) is str and bool(value.strip()), f"{label}: expected nonempty text")


def string_list(value, label):
    require(type(value) is list and bool(value), f"{label}: expected nonempty list")
    for item in value:
        nonempty(item, label)
    require(len(value) == len(set(value)), f"{label}: duplicate entries")

def safe_path(root, name):
    require(type(name) is str and bool(name), "unsafe empty path")
    require(not any(ord(char) < 32 for char in name) and "\\" not in name and ":" not in name,
            "unsafe path characters")
    parts = name.split("/")
    require(all(part not in ("", ".", "..") and not part.endswith((".", " ")) for part in parts),
            "unsafe path components")
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    path = root
    for part in parts:
        path /= part
        require(not path.is_symlink() and not path.is_junction(), f"link/junction forbidden: {name}")
    require(path.resolve().is_relative_to(root), f"path escapes repository: {name}")
    if path.is_file():
        require(path.stat().st_nlink == 1, f"hardlink forbidden: {name}")
    return path

def git_raw(root, *args, input_bytes=None):
    environment = os.environ.copy()
    # Inherited Git routing must not turn an injected root into a different repo.
    for name in tuple(environment):
        if name.startswith("GIT_"):
            environment.pop(name)
    environment["GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS"] = "0"
    environment["GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS"] = "1"
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "-c", "core.fsmonitor=false", "-C", str(root), *args],
        input=input_bytes, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        env=environment, check=False)
    require(result.returncode == 0, f"Git {' '.join(args[:2])}: failed ({result.returncode})")
    return result.stdout


def git(root, *args):
    return git_raw(root, *args).decode("utf-8")


def read_blobs(root, object_ids):
    object_ids = sorted(set(object_ids))
    require(all(type(oid) is str and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", oid)
                for oid in object_ids), "index: invalid batch blob ID")
    if not object_ids:
        return {}
    raw = git_raw(root, "cat-file", "--batch",
                  input_bytes=("\n".join(object_ids) + "\n").encode("ascii"))
    blobs, offset = {}, 0
    # Git frames each payload with its byte length, not a line count. This also
    # preserves multibyte UTF-8 and embedded newlines without a process per file.
    for oid in object_ids:
        newline = raw.find(b"\n", offset)
        require(newline >= offset, "index: truncated batch header")
        header = raw[offset:newline].split(b" ")
        require(len(header) == 3 and header[:2] == [oid.encode("ascii"), b"blob"]
                and header[2].isdigit(), "index: malformed batch header")
        start = newline + 1
        end = start + int(header[2])
        require(end < len(raw) and raw[end:end + 1] == b"\n",
                "index: truncated batch payload")
        blobs[oid] = normalize_text(raw[start:end].decode("utf-8"))
        offset = end + 1
    require(offset == len(raw), "index: trailing batch output")
    return blobs


def git_paths(output):
    require(not output or output.endswith("\0"), "Git returned malformed path list")
    return output[:-1].split("\0") if output else []


def harmless_cache(name):
    known = {
        (Path(path).parent / "__pycache__" / Path(path).stem).as_posix()
        for path in ALLOWED if path.endswith(".py")
    }
    match = re.fullmatch(r"(.+)\.cpython-312(?:\.opt-[12])?\.pyc", name)
    return bool(match and match.group(1) in known)


def read_index(root):
    entries = {}
    for record in git_paths(git(root, "ls-files", "--stage", "-z")):
        metadata, separator, name = record.partition("\t")
        fields = metadata.split()
        require(separator and len(fields) == 3, "Git returned malformed index entry")
        mode, oid, stage = fields
        safe_path(root, name)
        require(name in ALLOWED, f"out-of-scope path: {name}")
        require(stage == "0" and name not in entries, f"index: unresolved entry: {name}")
        require(mode in ("100644", "100755"), f"index: non-regular file: {name}")
        require(re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", oid), f"index: invalid blob ID: {name}")
        entries[name] = oid
    return entries


def inspect_git(root, *, ci=False, contents=None, complete_index=False):
    root = Path(root).resolve()
    require(Path(git(root, "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel").strip()).resolve() == root,
            "Git root differs from requested root")
    exact(git(root, "rev-parse", "--verify", f"{BASELINE}^{{commit}}").strip(), BASELINE,
          "Git baseline")
    git(root, "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", BASELINE, "HEAD")
    if not ci:
        exact(git(root, "symbolic-ref", "--quiet", "--short", "HEAD").strip(), BRANCH,
              "Git branch")
    diff_flags = ("--no-ext-diff", "--no-textconv", "--no-renames", "--name-only", "-z")
    committed = git_paths(git(root, "diff", *diff_flags, BASELINE, "HEAD", "--"))
    staged = git_paths(git(root, "diff", *diff_flags, "--cached", "--ita-invisible-in-index", "HEAD", "--"))
    removed = git_paths(git(root, "diff", *diff_flags, "--cached", "--ita-invisible-in-index",
                           "--diff-filter=D", "HEAD", "--"))
    working = git_paths(git(root, "diff", *diff_flags, "--"))
    entries = read_index(root)
    tracked = list(entries)
    head = git_paths(git(root, "ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", "-z", "HEAD", "--"))
    untracked = git_paths(git(root, "ls-files", "--others", "--exclude-standard", "-z"))
    ignored = git_paths(git(root, "ls-files", "--others", "--ignored", "--exclude-standard", "-z"))
    for name in set(committed + staged + working + tracked + head + untracked + ignored):
        safe_path(root, name)
        if name in ignored and harmless_cache(name):
            continue
        require(name in ALLOWED, f"out-of-scope path: {name}")
    required = set(ALLOWED) if complete_index else set(head)
    missing = (required - entries.keys()) | set(removed)
    require(not missing, f"index: missing commit candidate files: {', '.join(sorted(missing))}")
    indexed_blobs = read_blobs(root, entries.values())
    for name, oid in sorted(entries.items()):
        # Intent-to-add entries appear in ls-files but are omitted from a commit.
        require(name in head or name in staged, f"index: intent-to-add entry: {name}")
        indexed = indexed_blobs[oid]
        scan_secrets(f"index:{name}", indexed)
        if contents is None:
            working_text = read_text(root, name)
        else:
            require(name in contents, f"index: missing working input: {name}")
            working_text = contents[name]
        require(indexed == working_text, f"index/worktree mismatch: {name}; stage the final working content")
    # Historical evidence is not just in scope: its exact baseline content is immutable.
    baseline_entries = {}
    for record in git_paths(git(root, "ls-tree", "-r", "-z", BASELINE, "--", *IMMUTABLE)):
        metadata, separator, name = record.partition("\t")
        fields = metadata.split()
        require(separator and len(fields) == 3 and fields[1] == "blob",
                "immutable baseline: malformed entry")
        baseline_entries[name] = fields[2]
    exact(sorted(baseline_entries), sorted(IMMUTABLE), "immutable baseline paths")
    baseline_blobs = read_blobs(root, baseline_entries.values())
    for name, oid in baseline_entries.items():
        require(read_text(root, name) == baseline_blobs[oid],
                f"immutable historical input changed: {name}")
    # Git can omit an empty directory junction. Inspect links before descending,
    # excluding only Git's own metadata, which is not a construction input.
    directories = [root]
    while directories:
        directory = directories.pop()
        for path in directory.iterdir():
            if directory == root and path.name == ".git":
                continue
            safe_path(root, path.relative_to(root).as_posix())
            if path.is_dir():
                directories.append(path)
    return sorted(set(committed + staged + working + untracked +
                      [name for name in ignored if not harmless_cache(name)]))

    state = parse_json(contents["project-state/state.json"])
    for name in protected_paths(state):
        content = contents[name].encode("utf-8")
        hashes[name] = hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()

        aggregate.update(name.encode("utf-8") + b"\0" + str(len(content)).encode("ascii") +
                         b"\0" + content + b"\0")
    return aggregate.hexdigest(), hashes

def _validate_review_attestations(checked, current, *, paths, audit_path, next_gate,
                                  release_fields=(), release_verdict=LOCAL_RELEASE, p4n_repair=False):
    contract, state, contents, _changed = checked
    require(state["package_status"] == "implemented_unreleased", "gate: state is still building")
    receipts = []
    for name in paths:
        require(name in contents, f"missing required receipt: {name}")
        receipts.append(parse_json(contents[name]))
    saved, validation, review, release = receipts
    keys(saved, current, "bundle receipt")
    # Paths may move from untracked to committed after review; neither status nor HEAD is approval.
    for key, value in current.items():
        if key != "changed_paths":
            exact(saved[key], value, f"bundle receipt.{key}")
    require(type(saved["changed_paths"]) is list, "bundle receipt.changed_paths: expected list")
    require(all(type(name) is str and name in ALLOWED for name in saved["changed_paths"]),
            "bundle receipt.changed_paths: out of scope")
    exact(saved["changed_paths"], sorted(set(saved["changed_paths"])), "bundle receipt.changed_paths")
    common = {"schema_version": 1, "snapshot_id": current["snapshot_id"]}
    exact(validation, {**common, "role": "builder_validation", "verdict": "PASS",
                       "commands": [{"command": command, "exit_code": 0}
                                    for command in contract["required_validation"]],
                       "python_version": "3.12.10", "remote_ci": "NOT_RUN_AT_SNAPSHOT"},
          "validation receipt")
    keys(review, (*common, "role", "verdict", "agent_id", "read_only", "findings", "repair_cycles"),
         "review receipt")
    for key, value in {**common, "role": "reviewer", "verdict": "PASS", "read_only": True,
                       "findings": []}.items():
        exact(review[key], value, f"review receipt.{key}")
    cycles = review["repair_cycles"]
    audit_cycles = parse_json(contents[audit_path])["repair_cycles"]
    if p4n_repair:
        # This exact historical P4N exception cannot affect active P4B review.
        exact(contract.get("package_id"), "P4N", "repair exception contract package")
        exact(state.get("active_package"), "P4N", "repair exception state package")
        exact(current.get("package_id"), "P4N", "repair exception bundle package")
        for label, binding in (("contract", contract), ("state", state)):
            exact(binding.get("repair_exception"), REPAIR_EXCEPTION, f"{label}.repair_exception")
        require("governance/policy.toml" in contents, "repair exception: missing policy")
        exact(tomllib.loads(contents["governance/policy.toml"]), NBS_POLICY, "repair exception policy")
        require(type(audit_cycles) is int and 0 <= audit_cycles <= 1,
                "review receipt: planning repair bound or reset")
        exact(cycles, 2, "review receipt: repair bound or reset")
        exact(review["agent_id"], REPAIR_EXCEPTION["reviewer_agent"],
              "review receipt: same approved repair Reviewer")
    else:
        require(type(audit_cycles) is int and type(cycles) is int and 0 <= audit_cycles <= cycles <= 1,
                "review receipt: repair bound or reset")
    keys(release, (*common, "role", "verdict", "agent_id", "read_only", "remote_ci", "pr_url",
                   "merge_status", "vps_sync", "next_gate", *release_fields), "release receipt")
    for key, value in {**common, "role": "release_checker", "read_only": True,
                       "verdict": release_verdict,
                       "remote_ci": "NOT_RUN_AT_SNAPSHOT",
                       "pr_url": None, "merge_status": "not_merged", "vps_sync": "not_requested",
                       "next_gate": next_gate}.items():
        exact(release[key], value, f"release receipt.{key}")
    for role, receipt in (("reviewer", review), ("release_checker", release)):
        nonempty(receipt["agent_id"], f"{role}.agent_id")
        require(receipt["agent_id"] == receipt["agent_id"].strip() and
                receipt["agent_id"] not in state["builder_agents"], f"{role}: builder self-review")
    require(release["agent_id"] != review["agent_id"],
            "release_checker: needs a separate independent release agent")
    # Identity strings bind records, not authenticity. Actual independence needs external audit.
    return release

CHECKPOINT_FILE_BYTES = 1024 * 1024
CHECKPOINT_TOTAL_BYTES = 2 * 1024 * 1024


def _checkpoint_contents(contents, basis):
    """Rebuild reviewed phase-A text without importing it or relying on Git history."""
    commit = basis["checkpoint_commit"]
    require(commit is None or (type(commit) is str and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", commit)),
            "repair basis: checkpoint commit must be null or full provenance hash")
    artifact_hashes = basis["checkpoint_artifact_hashes"]
    keys(artifact_hashes, DIAGNOSTIC_ATTESTATIONS, "repair basis.checkpoint_artifact_hashes")
    for name in DIAGNOSTIC_ATTESTATIONS:
        exact(sha256(contents[name]), artifact_hashes[name], f"frozen diagnostic artifact: {name}")
    saved = parse_json(contents[DIAGNOSTIC_ATTESTATIONS[0]])
    require(type(saved) is dict, "repair basis: diagnostic bundle required")
    hashes = saved.get("protected_file_hashes")
    keys(hashes, PROTECTED, "repair basis: checkpoint protected hashes")
    for name, digest in hashes.items():
        require(type(digest) is str and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", digest),
                f"repair basis: invalid checkpoint hash: {name}")
    changed = {name for name in PROTECTED if sha256(contents[name]) != hashes[name]}
    archived = basis["checkpoint_inputs"]
    keys(archived, changed, "repair basis: checkpoint inputs")
    total = 0
    for name, text in archived.items():
        require(type(text) is str and normalize_text(text) == text,
                f"repair basis: checkpoint input must be LF text: {name}")
        size = len(text.encode("utf-8"))
        total += size
        require(size <= CHECKPOINT_FILE_BYTES, "repair basis: checkpoint input exceeds per-file limit")
        require(total <= CHECKPOINT_TOTAL_BYTES, "repair basis: checkpoint inputs exceed total limit")
        scan_secrets(f"checkpoint:{name}", text)
    frozen = {**contents, **archived}
    for name in PROTECTED:
        exact(sha256(frozen[name]), hashes[name], f"repair basis: checkpoint input hash: {name}")
    for name in IMMUTABLE:
        exact(frozen[name], contents[name], f"repair basis: immutable historical input: {name}")
    return frozen

    for command in ("check", "prompt", "bundle", "gate"):
        subparser = subparsers.add_parser(command)
        subparser.add_argument("--ci", action="store_true",
                               help="skip local branch identity only; retain baseline/scope/permission checks")
        if command == "prompt":
            subparser.add_argument("--verify", action="store_true")
    for command in ("probe-gate", "preparation-gate", "nbs-gate", "market-gate",
                    "diagnostic-gate", "verification-gate"):
        subparsers.add_parser(command).add_argument(
            "--ci", action="store_true", help="capability remains closed even in CI")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

        def mutations(value, path=()):
            yield path, None
            if type(value) is dict:
                yield path, {**value, "unapproved": False}
                for key, item in value.items():
                    yield path, {name: data for name, data in value.items() if name != key}
                    yield from mutations(item, (*path, key))
            elif type(value) is list:
                yield path, value[:-1] if value else ["unapproved"]
                for index, item in enumerate(value):
                    yield from mutations(item, (*path, index))
            elif type(value) is bool:
                yield path, int(value)
                yield path, not value
            elif type(value) is int:
                yield path, value + 1
                yield path, bool(value)
            else:
                yield path, value + " changed"

        for path, bad in mutations(self.register):
            changed = deepcopy(self.register)
            if path:
                target = changed
                for key in path[:-1]:
                    target = target[key]
                target[path[-1]] = bad
            else:
                changed = bad
            text = json.dumps(changed, indent=2) + "\n"
            # Isolate schema validation from the independently tested content pin.

def toml_fixture(value):
    def scalar(item):

    return "\n".join(key + " = " + scalar(item) for key, item in value.items()) + "\n"
